Auth bills hide in the unit.

MAU vs MRU

Clerk’s MRU skips one-day users, so it is never higher than your MAU. Pricing Clerk on your MAU count overstates its bill unless you count only retained users.

Per-connection SSO

WorkOS and Stytch charge per enterprise connection ($125 entry). Clerk includes one on Pro then $75. Kinde Plus includes unlimited SSO in the base.

Silent fee starts

Clerk Directory Sync billing begins 2027-01-01 — logged in our price log before it hits invoices.

Questions

What does AuthCost compare?

Published list prices for auth and identity vendors: base plan fees, MAU/MRU allowances and overages, and enterprise SSO / Directory Sync connection fees. Every row links the vendor’s own pricing page and the date we checked it.

MAU vs MRU — why does it matter?

Most vendors bill Monthly Active Users (any activity that month). Clerk bills Monthly Retained Users — a user who returns at least one day after signup. MRU is never higher than MAU for the same app, so pricing Clerk on your MAU count overstates Clerk’s bill unless you count only retained users.

Why are some rows blank?

We never invent a number. If a rate is “contact sales,” custom, or not printed as a fixed figure on the official page, we leave it blank and mark the gap.

How is the calculator’s cost computed?

Monthly ≈ base + max(0, users − included) × overage + SSO fees from the published ladder + SCIM / Directory Sync fees for the SSO customers you say need it (separate connection, shared pool or included, per the vendor’s page) + verified MFA add-ons when MFA is required. Firebase / Identity Platform, Supabase and Cognito bill SAML/OIDC per SSO user, not per connection, so we assume 200 SSO users per connection by default (change it in the calculator; see the sensitivity table in the methodology). B2B organization fees are added where the vendor publishes them (Clerk’s B2B Authentication add-on and per-org fees, Descope and Kinde per-tenant/org fees, Logto’s Organizations add-on), and plans over a published org cap (Auth0 Free 5, Auth0 B2C 10, Descope Free 10 tenants, Kinde Free 5) are left out. Every SSO connection counts as at least one customer organization. Token-based plans (Logto) use base + SSO (+ MFA add-on if required) only unless noted. We never invent an MFA price.

Do affiliate links change rankings?

No. Ranking is by computed cost only. Affiliate links are labeled when active.
